que_es: GUARDIANA front page (new home), Spanish source. Translate every key; the page shows text nodes one by one, so fragments listed in "trozos" are joined in order on screen.

titular_es.nota: Words appear one by one; "g" is the last part, shown in a blue-to-gold gradient (in Spanish «quién los compra?»). "br" = index of the word after which the line breaks on wide screens (-1 for none). sep "" for languages written without spaces.
